entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David... I hope you can help me. I need to... I need to make a return, and I'm just so disappointed about the whole thing.

I'm very sorry to hear you're disappointed. I can definitely look into that for you. To start, could I get your name and order number? And just so I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's Maria Sanchez, order VF99821. It's the new helmet I ordered. It's not a fault, I guess it's a preference. The online color just looked so different. I feel awful about it. I've been a loyal customer for so long and I saved up for this. I really needed this money back if it wasn't going to be perfect.
I understand completely, Maria. It's important that you love your gear, especially something as critical for safety as a helmet. Let me pull up your account. And you said you haven't used it yet?
Oh, no, of course not. The box is still unopened. I saw the color through the little window on the packaging and my heart just sank.

Thank you for clarifying. I've got your order details here and I see it was delivered just eight days ago. You're well within our 90-day return period for this helmet, so we can absolutely process a full refund for you. There's no need to feel guilty; getting the right color is part of the experience.
Really? Oh, thank goodness. That's such a relief to hear. I was so worried I'd be stuck with it.

Not at all. And I see here you're a VIP member with us, Maria. We truly appreciate your loyalty. To make this as easy as possible, I've just waived the standard return shipping fee and sent a pre-paid return label to the email address on your account. Is that email still correct?
Yes, it is! Wow, thank you, David. You've completely turned my day around. That's so helpful.

It's my pleasure. Just print that label, attach it to the original box, and you can drop it off at any postal service location. Once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be issued. Can I help with anything else today?
No, that's everything. Thank you so much for your help!
You are very welcome, Maria. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
